**Result: no estimate.** The embedded emissions cannot be calculated because the CN code is missing.

The ruleset requires a good CN code that appears in the factor table. The PO lists the CN code as "(to be confirmed)," so the factor (SEE) cannot be selected. The description "steel long product" does not identify a single heading, so I have not assumed one.

**Türkiye rows in the factor table, for the mill to choose from:**

| CN code | Good | Default SEE (tCO2e/t) |
|---|---|---|
| 7201 | Pig iron and spiegeleisen, in pigs, blocks or other primary forms | 1.85 |
| 7206 10 00 | Ingots, of iron and non-alloy steel (excl. remelted scrap ingots) | 1.96 |
| 7207 11 90 | Semi-finished products of iron or non-alloy steel | 3.087 |
| 7214 20 00 | Bars and rods, of iron or non-alloy steel, with indentations, ribs, grooves or other deformations | 2.31 |

**To complete the calculation:** Confirm the CN code with the mill. Once the code is confirmed, the calculation is:

Embedded emissions = SEE × 1,000 t

The result will be rounded half-up to 2 decimal places. The quantity (1,000 t) and country (Türkiye) are already provided, so only the CN code is outstanding.
